             \(\frac{4x}{6y}\)        =    \( \frac{100}{165}\)
              \(\frac{x}{y}\)        =    \( \frac{150}{165}\)
              \(\frac{x}{y}\)        =    \(\left.\frac{10}{11}\right\}\) +1

तीसरे विक्रेता का लाभ % = 1/10 × 100% =10%

question:
Ramnarayan's salary was reduced by 3\(\frac{1}{8}\)%, and then, the reduced salary was increased by 7\(\frac{2}{5}\)%. By what percentage (rounded off to two decimal places) is his new salary more/less as compared to his original salary?

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 4.04% more.

Increased salary (x) = 7\(\frac{2}{5}\)% = \(\frac{37}{5}\) = 7.4 
Reduced salary (y)  = 3\(\frac{1}{8}\)% = \(\frac{25}{8}\) = 3.125 
Percentage = x – y – \(xy\over100\)
= 7.4 - 3.125 – \(\frac{7.4\ \times\ 3.125}{100}\)
= 4.275 - 0.231 
= 4.04% more

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 4.04% अधिक है।

बढ़ा हुआ वेतन (x) = 7\(\frac{2}{5}\)% = \(\frac{37}{5}\) = 7.4 
कम हुआ वेतन (y)  = 3\(\frac{1}{8}\)% = \(\frac{25}{8}\) = 3.125 
प्रतिशत = x – y – \(xy\over100\)
= 7.4 - 3.125 – \(\frac{7.4\ \times\ 3.125}{100}\)
= 4.275 - 0.231 
= 4.04% अधिक

question:
An employee gets two successive increments in his salary, as a result of which his salary becomes 2.5 times the initial salary. What was his first percentage increment, if the second percentage increment was 4 times as high as the first?

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 25%.

Let, first increment = x% 
second increment = 4x% 
x + 4x + \(\frac{4x\times x}{100}\) = 150% 
5x + \(\frac{4x^2}{100}\) = 150% 
125x + x² = 150 × 25 
x²+ 125x - 3750 = 0 
x²+150x - 25x - 3750
x(x + 150) - 25(x + 150) = 0
(x + 150) (x - 25)
⇒ x = 25%

माना, पहली वृद्धि = x%
दूसरी वृद्धि = 4x%
x + 4x + \(\frac{4x\times x}{100}\) = 150% 
5x + \(\frac{4x^2}{100}\) = 150% 
125x + x² = 150 × 25 
x²+ 125x - 3750 = 0 
x²+150x - 25x - 3750
x(x + 150) - 25(x + 150) = 0
(x + 150) (x - 25)
⇒ x = 25%

question:

question:
In a class, the ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls is 11 : 9. 30% of the boys and 20% of the girls passed an exam. Find the percentage of students who passed the exam.

(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 25.5%.

                Boys    :     Girls
No. →        11     :    9
Pass →    30%    :     20%

Overall Pass% ⇒  \(\frac{11\times30+9\times20}{11+9}\)
⇒\( \left(\frac{330\ +\ 180}{20}\right)\)%
⇒\( \frac{510}{20}\)% ⇒ 25.5%

Alternatively:-

Let overall pass% = 20%
Deviation ⇒ +10 × 11 +0 = +110
Pass% ⇒ 20+ \(\frac{110}{20}\)
⇒20+5.5
⇒ 25.5%
question_hi:
एक कक्षा में लड़कों और लड़कियों की सख्या का अनुपात 11:9 है। 30% लड़कों और 20% लड़कियों ने एक परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण की। परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने वाले विद्यार्थियों का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।

                Boys    :     Girls

उत्तीर्ण →   30%    :     20%

कुल उत्तीर्ण% ⇒  \(\frac{11\times30+9\times20}{11+9}\)
⇒\( \left(\frac{330\ +\ 180}{20}\right)\)%
⇒\( \frac{510}{20}\)% ⇒ 25.5%

वैकल्पिक रूप से:-

कुल उत्तीर्ण% = 20%
विचलन ⇒ +10 × 11 +0 = +110
उत्तीर्ण% ⇒ 20+ \(\frac{110}{20}\)
⇒20+5.5
⇒ 25.5%

question:
In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B and C. The candidate secured 75% marks in Paper A, 80% marks in Paper B, and 60% marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B and C were 40%, 50% and 10%, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all the three papers were taken together.

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 76%.

                             A              B             C
Marks →           75%          80%         60%
Weight (age)→ 40%    :    50%    :     10% 
                             4        :     5        :      1

combine the weighted percentage of all three papers
= \(\frac{75\times4+80\times5+60\times1}{4+5+1\ }\)%  
= \(\frac{300+400+60}{10\ }\)
= \(\frac{760}{10}\)% 
= 76%
question_hi:
एक परीक्षा में एक परीक्षार्थी को तीन पेपर A. B और C में बैठना था। परीक्षार्थी ने पेपर A में 75% अंक, पेपर B में 80% अंक और पेपर C में 60% अंक प्राप्त किए। यदि पेपर A, B और C को क्रमशः 40%, 50% और 10% भारांक दिए गए थे, तो तीनों पेपरों में एकसाथ परीक्षार्थी द्वारा प्राप्त अंकों का भारित प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 76% है।

                             A              B             C
अंक →                 75%         80%         60%
भार (आयु)→       40%    :    50%    :    10% 
                             4        :     5        :      1

तीनों पेपरों का भारित प्रतिशत

= \(\frac{75\times4+80\times5+60\times1}{4+5+1\ }\)%  
= \(\frac{300+400+60}{10\ }\)
= \(\frac{760}{10}\)% 
= 76%

question:
A certain number of students from school X appeared in an examination and 30% students failed. 150% more students than those from school X, appeared in the same examination from school Y. solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 16.

Total students who passed from both X & Y 
80% of total (350) = 280
Pass only in Y = 280 - 70 = 210 
Fail in Y = 40
%= 40/250 × 100 = 16%

(CGL MAINS 2019)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 16 है।

कुल (350) का 80% = 280
केवल Y में उत्तीर्ण = 280 - 70 = 210
Y में अनुत्तीर्ण = 40
%= 40/250 × 100 = 16%

question:

question:

solution:

question:

question:
A test consists of 200 questions. Anamica answered 40% of the first 70 questions correctly. What percentage of the remaining 130 questions does she need to answer correctly to score 59.5% marks in the test?

(SP Phase-8)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 70%.

59.5% of 200 = 119

Correct question by Anamica in first 70 = 40% of 70 = 28

Required percentage = (91/130) × 100 = 70%

(SP Phase-8)
solution_hi:

200 का 59.5% = 119

पहले 70 में अनामिका द्वारा सही प्रश्न = 70 का 40% = 28

अतः, 130 में अनामिका द्वारा सही प्रश्न = 119 - 28 = 91

आवश्यक प्रतिशत = (91/130) × 100 = 70%

question:
In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 7,68,400 votes. solution:

According to the question

⇒ 80% - 82560 = 4802500

⇒ 20% = [(4802500 + 82560)/80] × 20 = 1221265

question:
In an election between two candidates, y% of the voters did not vote. 10% of the votes cast were declared invalid, while all the valid votes were cast in favour of either of the two candidates. (CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 8.

Let polled votes = x % 
Winning margin = 59.375 - 40.625 = 18.75% 
∴ 16000 × \(\frac{x}{100}\) × \(\frac{9}{10}\) × \(\frac{18.75}{100}\)

x = \(\frac{2484\ \times\ 100\ \times\ 100}{16\ \times\ 9\ \times\ 1875}\) 
= \(\frac{92\ \times\ 100\ \times\ 100}{16\ \times\ 625}\) = 92

∴ Did not vote = 100-92 = 8%
question_hi:
दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच हुए चुनाव में, y% मतदाताओं ने मतदान नहीं किया। डाले गए 10% वोट अवैध घोषित कर दिए गए, जबकि सभी वैध वोट दोनों में से किसी एक उम्मीदवार के पक्ष में डाले गए। जिस उम्मीदवार को डाले गए वैध वोटों का 59.375% मिला, उसे 2484 वोटों से निर्वाचित घोषित किया गया। यदि उस चुनाव में मतदान करने के योग्य लोगों की संख्या 16,000 थी, तो y का मान क्या है?

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 8 है।

माना डाले गए वोट = x % 
जीत का अंतर = 59.375 - 40.625 = 18.75% 
∴ 16000 × \(\frac{x}{100}\) × \(\frac{9}{10}\) × \(\frac{18.75}{100}\)
= 2484 
x = \(\frac{2484\ \times\ 100\ \times\ 100}{16\ \times\ 9\ \times\ 1875}\) 
= \(\frac{92\ \times\ 100\ \times\ 100}{16\ \times\ 625}\) = 92

∴ वोट नहीं दिया = 100-92 = 8%

question:
Three candidates X, Y and Z participated in an election. X got 30% more votes than Y, whereas Z got 25% more votes than Y. X also overtook Z by 5000 votes. If 71% of the voters voted and no invalid votes were cast, then what was the total number of voters in the voting list?

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 5,00,000.

Voted = 26 + 20 + 25 = 71 
1 unit → 5000 votes 
Total votes = 100 unit 
100 unit → 5000 × 100 = 500000
question_hi:
तीन उम्मीदवार X, Y और Z ने एक चुनाव में भाग लिया। X को Y से 30% अधिक वोट मिले, जबकि Z को Y से 25% अधिक वोट मिले। X ने Z को 5000 वोटों से पीछे छोड़ दिया। यदि 71% मतदाताओं ने मतदान किया और कोई भी अवैध वोट नहीं डाला गया, तो मतदान सूची में कुल मतदाताओं की संख्या क्या थी?

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 5,00,000 है।

मतदान = 26 + 20 + 25 = 71
1 इकाई → 5000 वोट
कुल वोट = 100 इकाई
100 इकाई → 5000 × 100 = 500000
